FX-WARP-001.says: The settings as they start: Arc, Bend 50: the drawing bent round a circle, its middle line an eighth of a turn, the sides drooping.

FX-WARP-002.says: Bend 0, both Distortions 0: the drawing, untouched.

FX-WARP-003.says: Arc Lower, Bend 50: the bottom edge bowed down, the top kept.

FX-WARP-004.says: Arc Upper, Bend 50: the top edge bowed up, the bottom kept.

FX-WARP-005.says: Arch, Bend 50: lifted in the middle, the sides kept upright, clear below the middle.

FX-WARP-006.says: Bulge, Bend 50: the top and bottom bowed out together, cut off at the edges.

FX-WARP-007.says: Shell Lower, Bend 50: the bottom bowed down and narrowed toward it.

FX-WARP-008.says: Shell Upper, Bend 50: the top bowed up and narrowed toward it.

FX-WARP-009.says: Flag, Bend 50: one whole wave across, every row alike.

FX-WARP-010.says: Wave, Bend 50: the wave half a turn on from the top to the bottom.

FX-WARP-011.says: Fish, Bend 50: thick at one end and thin at the other.

FX-WARP-012.says: Rise, Bend 50: the right side raised and the left lowered, smoothly.

FX-WARP-013.says: Fisheye, Bend 50: swollen from the middle, the corners kept.

FX-WARP-014.says: Inflate, Bend 50: swollen both ways, the corners kept.

FX-WARP-015.says: Squeeze, Bend 50: drawn in across and swollen up and down.

FX-WARP-016.says: Twist, Bend 50: turned most in the middle, the corners kept.

FX-WARP-017.says: Arc at Bend -50: bent the other way, the sides lifted, the mirror image of FX-WARP-001 top for bottom.

FX-WARP-018.says: Flag with Warp Axis vertical: the wave runs down the drawing, the columns sway.

FX-WARP-019.says: Bend 0, Horizontal Distortion 60: no bend, the right side taller than the left, cut off where it passes the edges.

FX-WARP-020.says: Bend 0, Vertical Distortion -60: the bottom narrower than the top.

FX-WARP-021.says: Bulge, Bend 40, with both Distortions at 30.

FX-WARP-022.says: Bend keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear, Twist: frame 0 the drawing, frame 4 a whole Twist, frame 2 between.

FX-WARP-023.says: Bend keyed from 60 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 2 would pass 100 and is held there, the same as frame 4.

FX-WARP-024.says: FX-WARP-001 with the layer moved three pixels right: the bent drawing moves with it.

FX-WARP-025.says: Twist at Bend 100 with Warp Axis vertical: u and v change places, so the turn runs the other way round from FX-WARP-022's frame 4.

FX-WARP-026.says: Warp Style "spiral", not one of the fifteen. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WARP-027.says: Warp Axis "diagonal". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WARP-028.says: Bend 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WARP-029.says: Horizontal Distortion -101, below -100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WARP-030.says: Vertical Distortion keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
